latest_release.name: v2.20.2
latest_release.body: ## Announcement Read the official announcement: [Announcing GoReleaser v2.20](https://goreleaser.com/blog/goreleaser-v2.20/). ## Changelog ### Security updates * 84f5ed6689a1a2b4112f1085d96cf6a6ddb11a5e: sec: redact Git publication and SBOM credentials (#7303) (@caarlos0) ### Bug fixes * b6d7c4e4cb095d80c903b1ce66f02db69597cff0: fix(checksums): do not fail split checksums without artifacts (#7306) (@David-Uka) * 2a662ce09e733ca040ddc3029c428becef4b273d: fix(redact): avoid empty writes for buffered secret prefixes (#7301) (@David-Uka and @caarlos0) * 89fdc4036bb6133a08518369bf1ce760281c5dab: fix(telegram): use an HTML-escaped default message with parse_mode HTML (#7285) (@pcbeingused333 and @caarlos0) ### Other work * fb186216f22b0dce0c9e95ee190a15dc5734afc5: chore(deps): update Go to 1.27.4 (#7296) (@caarlos0) * 33e401312a58d063e6e086dc54737db10d83a0bf: chore: auto-update generated files (#7297) (@goreleaserbot) * 6eedb82fdcb9f6a40d7e065e4c249ac2bc00f50b: chore: auto-update generated files (#7302) (@goreleaser[bot]) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/compare/v2.20.1...v2.20.2 ## Helping out This release is only possible thanks to **all** the support of some **awesome people**! Want to be one of them? You can [sponsor](https://goreleaser.com/sponsors/), get a [Pro License](https://goreleaser.com/pro) or [contribute with code](https://goreleaser.com/contributing). ## Where to go next? * Find examples and commented usage of all options in our [website](https://goreleaser.com/intro/). * Reach out on [Discord](https://discord.gg/RGEBtg8vQ6), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/goreleaser), and [Telegram](https://t.me/goreleasernews)!
